sentences: Bounded derivation depth limits how far a rule-based reasoning process must unfold to answer the relevant queries.
The source asks whether this property implies finite controllability.
Finite controllability compares reasoning over all models with reasoning restricted to finite models, which is crucial when interpreting database constraints.
The proposed implication would connect a bound on inference depth with the ability to find finite witnesses to failure.
